description: A splat over the dynamic value doesn't evaluate the traversal after it
notes: The spec doesn't say whether the traversal of a splat over an unknown value is evaluated. SplatExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression.go) returns the dynamic value for a dynamic source without evaluating its traversal, so the undefined variable in the index isn't reported, as in a for expression over an unknown list (native/unknowns/for-over-unknown-list-skips-body-type-check).
